slides.title: US policy on Ethiopia: key points
State Dept urges dialogue
slides.body: Ethiopia and Eritrea should respect each other's sovereignty and return to dialogue, per CRS.

slides.title: Lawmakers urge de-escalation
slides.body: Several Senate and House Democrats asked for restraint, CRS reports.

slides.title: Aid is shrinking
slides.body: CRS says the US has reduced foreign aid to Ethiopia, including humanitarian aid.

slides.title: Protect civilians, keep aid access open
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Congressional Research Service, In Focus IF13344 (Nov 6, 2026)
